title: peraxilla haastii
intro: Peraxilla haastii, commonly known as the Kawakawa or New Zealand pepper tree, is a plant species native to New Zealand. The Kawakawa has been used in traditional Maori medicine for its health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, improving digestion, and acting as an antibacterial agent. The therapeutic actions of Peraxilla haastii include stimulating the immune system, reducing blood pressure, and acting as a natural pain reliever. The bioactive constituents of the plant include a variety of alkaloids and polyphenols, including flavonoids and lignans, which contribute to its therapeutic effects.
